question: Who among the following won the men’s singles title at the Toyota Thailand Open badminton tournament in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Viktor Axelsen**__.

__
 
• The Toyota Thailand Open was a badminton tournament that took place at the Impact Arena in Thailand from 19 to 24 January 2021.
 
• **Viktor Axelsen **won the men’s singles title at the Toyota Thailand Open badminton tournament in January 2021.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Viktor Axelsen of Denmark took the gold medal in the men's singles badminton at the Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games.
 
• He is the 2017 World Champion and the gold medalist at the 2020 Summer Olympics.
 
• He becomes the first non-Asian man to claim the singles title since 1996.
 
• He beat China's defending champion Chen Long.
